--C. by Kamalaśīla. Cordier III. p. 366.

Avikalpapraveśa_Nāma_Mahāyānasūtra

Bud. Cordier III. p. 156.

Avicāraramaṇīyakathā
TD. 23658-60.

Avijñānakṛtajapaphala
Ānandāśrama 3612.

Aviditasukhaduh2khapadyasya_Ṭīkā
adv. Bikaner 6390. Twelve interpretations by Nandīśa on a verse ascribed to Pakṣadhara Miśra. See Poona Ori. XII. 1-4. p.. 74-6.

Avidūrenidāna
Bud. Pāli. See Malalaśekhara, Pāli Lit. Ceylon, p. 125.

Aviddhakarṇa
a Naiyāyika. Q. by Śāntarakṣita in his Tattvasaṅgraha an. the Pañcikā on it; see GOS. 30, 31, p.. 41, 42. Intro. p.. lxxxviii-lxxviii an. 41. 136 an. Index ibid. p. 86. For the passage q. in [Page427-a. I Kāṇḍa, see p. 100, of the Sammatitarka, Gujarat Purātattva Mandir, Ahmedabad, where also this passage is q.

Aviddhakarṇa
a cārvāka writter, C. 820. A. D. mentioned by Karṇakagomin in his C. on Pramāṇavārttikavṛtti an. Anantavīrya in his Siddhiviniścayaṭīkā. See Eng. Intro. to Vol. I p.. 76-77. Bhāratīya Jnānapīṭha, Kasi, edn. (p. 306).
See also Tattvasaṅgrahapañcikā, p.. 136. 187. 213. 225. 422 (a. anuṣṭubh). 455.
--Tattvaṭīkā. ibid. p. 432 (aviddhakarNastattvaTIkAyAmAha).

Avidyākarmaphalabheda
from Mahābhārata. Trav. Uni. L. 1427G.

Avidyākhaṇḍana
viś. adv. Adyar D. X. 136. Extr. p.. 222-3.
--viś. adv. a.. in verses. Adyar D. X. 138. Extr. p. 224 (inc.).
--by Varadācārya, son of Vedāntadeśika. Adyar D. X. 137. Extr. p. 223.

Avidyādharīgītastava_(?)
in rāga Lalita. by Pratāpamalla. Nepal II. p. 239.

Avidyāpiśāca(cī)bhañjana
adv. by Amareśvara Śāstrin of Kambhampāṭi family. Mysore I. p. 424. TA. 1651/2.

Avidyāprakaraṇa
vedānta. Oppert II. 3480.

Avidyālakṣaṇopapatti
ved. by Tryambaka Śāstrin. Rice 134. Trav. Uni. 10057A (a..).

Avidhavānavamīśrāddhasaṅkalpa
Pt.. Ṛgvedībrahmakarma. 2nd edn. Bombay, 1886. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 245.

Avidhimataviṣauṣadha
Jain. Śvet. by Harṣabhūṣaṇagaṇi. See also under Añcalamatadalanaprakaraṇa. BORI. D. XVIII. i. 76. [Page427-b]

Avināśisvāmin
or avinAzIzvara of the Vandavāsi family; son of Rāma of Ātreyagotra; grandson of Īśvara an. pupil of Śeṣādriguru; scholar in Sūryasiddhānta; wrote the following a. Varadarājapuram near Seringapatam during the time of Cāma-(Sāma-)rāja, son of Kṛṣṇarāja, of Mysore, 19th Cent. latter part.
--Śṛṅgārarājatilaka Bhāṇa. MD. 12708.

Avinīta
C. 600. A. D. the Gāṅga king Durvinīta, contemporary of poet Bhāravi, Eastern Cālukya King Kubja Viṣṇuvardhana, an. the Pallava King Siṁhaviṣṇu. See above p. 420b. Said to have written
--C. on the 15th canto of Bhāravi's Kirātarjunīya.
--Sanskrit version of the Bṛhatkathā.
--Śabdāvatāra. gr.
See JRAS. 1883, p. 298. 1911, p. 187. 1913, p.. 389-390. Mys. Arch. Rep. 1912, paras 65-69.

Avibhaktadhanaviṣaya
dh. TD. 19033.

Avibhaktabhrātṛputravibhāgavicāra
dh. Mysore I. p.. 95. 112 (dāyabhāgavicāra).

Avimāraka
The romance of Avimāraka an. Kuraṅgī is alluded to by Vātsyāyana in his Kāmasūtras, an. in the Kaumudīmahotsava also. See also Gaṇaratnamahodadhi, Eggeling's edn., p. 349. For the story see Kathāsaritsāgara, Taraṅga 112, śls. 89 ff.

Avimāraka
drama ascribed to Bhāsa.
Adyar II. p. 27a (inc.). Adyar D. V. 1311. Trav. Uni. 3168C. 5150A. Trippūṇittura I. 98 (2). 976 (9).
For variant readings of Avimāraka, see fol.. 37a-39a of MT. 3810 (c). [Page428-a.
Pt.. (1) TSS. 20. (2) with Eng. transl. by C. R. Devadhar, Poona Ori. Ser. 72, 1940.
For a. Eng. transl. see Woolner an. Sarup, Thirteen Trivandrum plays attributed to Bhāsa, Punjab Uni. Ori. Publications 13. (1930) Vol. II. p.. 59-108.

Avimukta
(found in mss. a. Vimukta also. IO. i. p. 530a. Rajapur list extracts under no. 244).
The Kūṭastha of Rāmacandra (Prakriyākaumudī); belonged to a. Āndhravaṁśa, of the Kauṇḍinyagotra an. Ṛgveda. His descendants were worshippers of Viṭṭhala, learned in Pāñcarātra, an. Vallabha Vaiṣṇavas.
See concluding verses 3-4, Viṭṭhala's Prasāda on Prakriyākaumudī of Rāmacandra.
See also the concluding verses of Nṛsiṁha's gloss on Kālanirṇayadīpikā of his father Rāmacandra. IO. i. p. 530a.

Avimuktajābālopaniṣat
See Jābālopaniṣad.

Avimuktatattva
māhātmya of Kāśī by Bālam Bhaṭṭa Pāyaguṇḍa, son of Vaidyanātha Pāyaguṇḍa; but ascribed to his stepmother Bhavānī. Mysore I. p. 179. Ujjain II. p. 56.
See V. Raghavan, NIA. I. p. 404; also Poona Ori. IV. 1-2, p.. 28-29, for a summary of contents an. list of authorities q.

Avimuktatīrtha
guru of Tallayārya (Kānādasaṅgrahavyākhyā-Nyāyaratnākara, MT. 1562 (b).

Avimuktanirukti
or Brahmāvāsa on salvation a. Benares an. based on the Jābālopaniṣad. Hall p. 133. Q. in the a. a.'s Avimuktaniruktisāra, BBRAS. 1097. [Page428-b]

Avimuktanirukti
by Nīlakaṇṭha Caturdhara. Q. in his Harivaṁśavyākhyā I. 29. 66. (vistarastvasmatkRtAyAmavimuktaniruktau draSTavyaH),

Avimuktaniruktisāra
dh. BBRAS. 1097.
--C. BBRAS. 1097.
--by Nīlakaṇṭha Caturdhara. Q. in his C. on Mahābhārata, Anuśāsanaparvan Adhy. 17 sl. 33. on the etymology of the word Śmaśānavāsī ? Probably this an. A. nirukti above are same.

Avimuktamāhātmya
from Śivapurāṇa, Oudh V. 2.
C.. Veṅk. Press edn. Śivapurāṇa, Book IV, Koṭirudrasaṁhitā, ch. 23, Kāśīmāhātmya.

Avimuktopaniṣad
Oppert I. 7527.

Avirodhatattvadīpikā(pāramahaṃsasaṃhitā)
vedānta. by Bharata. Adyar.

Avirodhaprakāśa
jy. by Yajñeśvara. Alwar 1715. Ānandāśrama 6089 (a..). K. 222. Sūcīpattra 16.
--C. Mitabhāṣiṇī by Rāmacandra. K. 236. Sūcīpattara 16.
Pt.. Text an. C., Bombay, 1837.

Avilamba
poet. 2 verses of his are cited in the Rasakalpadruma of Caturbhuja (1689 A. D.). Alwar Extr. p. 79.

Avilamba
poet. cited in Padyaracanā, K. M. 89. p. 54. Same a. the next ?

Avilamba(avilambita)sarasvatī
Q. in Padyāvalī. S. K. D.'s. edn. śl. 385. Title of Mādhava Sarasvatī, nephew of Madhusūdana Sarasvatī; preceptor of Pratāpāditya (of Bengal, 17th Cent.) who gave him that title. See C. Cakravarti, ABORI. IX. p. 309.
Some, however, hold it was Madhusūdana's brother Yādavānanda Nyāyācārya, who got the title Avilamba [Page429-a. Sarasvatī from King Pratāpāditya. See P. C. Diwanji, ABORI. IX. p. 318.
See J. Myth. Soc. XXVII. p. 280.

Avilambasarasvatī
title of the poet of a Kulīna family of Kaśyapagotra of Rāḍhā in Bengal, named Rāghavendra (alias Harihara ?), father of Cirañjivi Bhaṭṭācārya (a. of Vidvanmodataraṅgiṇī, TD. 8132. See śl. 15).

Avilambasarasvatī
a. alias of Trilocana, son of Pītāmbara Vidyānidhi of Mithila. See p. xiii. intro. to Vīrataraṅgiṇī of Citra dhara, ed. by Trilokanatha Jha, Darbhanga, 1965.

Avivartacakra
AMG. II. p. 267 (no. 3). AR. XX. p. 463.
C.. below Avaivartakacakrasūtra q. by Haribhadra in his Abhisamayālaṅkārāloka, GOS. LXII. p. 43.

Avivākyahautra
śr. BISM. v.. 904/22.

Āvirbhāvatirobhāva
vallabhīya. Ahmedabad 73 (40). See next.

Āvirbhāvatirobhāvavarṇana
vallabhīya. by Viṭṭhaleśvara. Udaipur II. 113. 5.

Āvirbhāvatirobhāvavāda
